audit.whatIsWrong: full.diff says EVEN while every other difficulty field in the same entry says hard — tone is the hard colour, diffRating is 7/10, breakdown.difficulty is 7/10 and the final rating line literally reads 'Hard matchup'.
audit.why: diff is the odd field out, and 48.19% over 193 games supports hard rather than even. One-word fix, no cascade.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 2-3 spike names the wrong combo: 'Acceleration Gate + To the Skies'. Those two abilities are in different stances and cannot be chained.
audit.why: Acceleration Gate is Cannon E and To the Skies! is Hammer Q. Gate empowers Shock Blast, the Cannon Q — 'If Shock Blast is fired through the gate the missile speed, range, and damage will increase.' Naming the wrong half of the combo means the reader watches for the wrong animation.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text now names Acceleration Gate into Shock Blast and says what the gate actually does to it.
sources: champ-data/_kits/jayce.json Q and E dual-stance descriptions

audit.whatIsWrong: Pillar of Ice is credited with a knockup in two fields ('threatens a knockup on his Gate placement', 'forces him to respect the knockup'). It has no knockup. Meanwhile the interaction that does exist — Pillar of Ice denying To the Skies! outright — appears nowhere.
audit.why: Riot text: Pillar of Ice 'creates an ice pillar at target location, becoming impassable terrain and slowing all nearby enemy units.' No displacement in the description. To the Skies! is Hammer Q, 'Leaps to an enemy' — a dash, and the missing-interactions file lists exactly this pairing as enemy-dash-deniable: hold Pillar for his engage, not for his poke.
audit.corrected: Replaced the knockup with the terrain-and-slow reality and added the dash denial, including the instruction to hold E for the engage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chomp is credited with an attack-speed steal or 'AS debuff' in mid and whys[4], and Mercury Cannon's resistance shred is never mentioned at all.
audit.why: Chomp saps Attack Damage. Mercury Cannon: 'The first attack in this form reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist' — which is directly relevant because it works against the resistances Subjugate just handed you.
audit.corrected: Swapped the AS claims for the AD drain and named the Mercury Cannon shred in whys[6].

audit.whatIsWrong: Shock Blast is called the matchup-defining cooldown and never given a number.
audit.why: Shock Blast is 16/14/12/10/8/6s across six ranks and Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate is 20/18/16/14/12/10s. At level 2 the poke returns every 16 seconds, which is the entire rhythm of the lane.
audit.corrected: Added the 16s rank-1 figure to the cooldown block and the key-interactions line.

edits.before: Jayce hits Acceleration Gate + To the Skies at level 2 — his burst combo comes online before yours and he can punish any step forward you take.
edits.after: Jayce hits Acceleration Gate into Shock Blast at level 2 — the gate raises the Q's speed, range and damage, and it lands before your kit exists.

edits.before: Pillar of Ice threatens a knockup on his Gate placement and keeps him honest, but neither of you can decisively win the skirmish — he kites, you control space, it stays neutral.
edits.after: Pillar of Ice is terrain, so it denies the ground he leaps over and slows him, but neither of you decisively wins the skirmish — he kites, you control space, it stays neutral.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are the hardest stretch of the lane. Jayce is maximising his Q and the accelerated Shock Blast from full cannon range now hits like a truck. Your Pillar of Ice is your only real deterrent — threaten it on his feet whenever he walks up to gate, which forces him to respect the knockup or trade into your Chomp. Farm and do not gift him a free lead. Everything changes at 6: Subjugate lets you walk through his kite. Lock Frozen Domain under yourself, eat one poke, then close — the armor you drain off him means his hammer-stance follow-up hits you for far less than he expects and your Chomp AS debuff makes his counter-trade feeble. This is your only clean all-in window; take it if he is not at full health.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are the hardest stretch of the lane. Jayce is maximising his Q and an accelerated Shock Blast from full cannon range hits like a truck. Pillar of Ice is your only real deterrent — it is impassable terrain, so it shuts off To the Skies! outright, and the slow around it forces him the long way round or into your Chomp. Hold it for his engage, never for his poke. Farm and do not gift him a free lead. Everything changes at 6: Subjugate lets you walk through the kite. Lock Frozen Domain under yourself, eat one poke, then close — the drained armor blunts his hammer follow-up, and the AD Chomp saps makes his counter-trade feeble. This is your only clean all-in window.

edits.before: Subjugate fires the moment you close gap: you drain his armor onto yourself mid-fight, and inside Frozen Domain his hammer-stance counter-trade is blunted by your Chomp attack-speed steal.
edits.after: Subjugate fires the moment you close: you drain his armor onto yourself mid-fight, and inside Frozen Domain his hammer-stance counter-trade is blunted by the AD Chomp keeps sapping off him.

edits.before: At full items Jayce has range, burst, and a knockback to reset your positioning — neither of you cleanly kills the other and the outcome depends on map geometry and cooldown timing.
edits.after: At full items Jayce has range, burst, a knockback, and a Mercury Cannon first hit that shreds the resists you drained — the outcome turns on map geometry and cooldown timing.

edits.before: Bait Jayce into burning his E knockback defensively, then walk onto Frozen Domain and Chomp him in the forced melee trade
edits.after: Bait Thundering Blow (E) out defensively, then walk onto Frozen Domain — Pillar is terrain and shuts To the Skies! off

edits.before: - Jayce Shock Blast: matchup-defining — His main poke. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Jayce To the Skies! / Shock Blast: Hammer: leap + slow. Cannon: a long-range artillery line. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Jayce Shock Blast: matchup-defining — 16s at rank 1, and Acceleration Gate empowers it. Dodge the line. - Jayce To the Skies!: the Hammer leap. Pillar of Ice is terrain and shuts it off — hold E for it.

edits.before: Track Jayce's Shock Blast: His main poke. Dodge it. When it is down — Bite + duel him.
edits.after: Shock Blast is 16s at rank 1. Pillar of Ice is terrain and shuts off To the Skies!.

notes: Disk 48.19% / 193; packet 47.34% / 188 — close agreement, unusually. The Acceleration-Gate-plus-To-the-Skies combo in spikes[0] was the worst error: those abilities live in opposite stances and cannot be chained, so the reader was being told to watch for something that never happens.
